release_notes:
FocusDefend v1.9.1 Release — Database Indexing & Ultra-Fast In-Memory Caching Engine:
• High-Performance Database Indexing: Added composite indexes to Room DB v14 on UnlockSessionEntity (packageName, remainingTimeMs, id), QuizSessionEntity, QuickPassRequestEntity (status, createdAt), and WellbeingInsightEntity for sub-millisecond query execution.
• Zero-Latency In-Memory Question Cache: Rewrote QuestionRepository to cache and asynchronously preload question banks from disk assets, reducing quiz load times from ~70ms to <0.01ms.
• Multi-Tier Domain Caching: FocusDefendCache now accelerates Study Hours, screen time aggregates, and user role lookups to eliminate UI lag.
• Special App Access Direct Navigation: Added exact paths and direct intent launch for Xiaomi HyperOS/MIUI 'Display pop-up windows while running in the background' under Special App Access.
